defmodule RepoManager do
  @moduledoc """
  Manages git repository operations for the build system.
  Uses argument-list form of System.cmd to prevent shell injection.
  """

  @max_url_length 512
  @max_path_length 256
  @allowed_schemes ["https://", "http://", "git://", "ssh://"]

  defmodule ValidationError do
    defexception [:message]
  end

  def clone_repository(repo_url, destination) do
    with {:ok, url} <- validate_url(repo_url),
         {:ok, dest} <- validate_destination(destination),
         {:ok, _} <- ensure_directory(dest) do
      execute_clone(url, dest)
    end
  end

  def clone_with_branch(repo_url, branch, destination) do
    with {:ok, url} <- validate_url(repo_url),
         {:ok, branch_name} <- validate_branch(branch),
         {:ok, dest} <- validate_destination(destination),
         {:ok, _} <- ensure_directory(dest) do
      execute_clone_branch(url, branch_name, dest)
    end
  end

  defp validate_url(url) when is_binary(url) do
    trimmed = String.trim(url)
    cond do
      String.length(trimmed) > @max_url_length ->
        {:error, "URL too long"}
      String.contains?(trimmed, "..") ->
        {:error, "Path traversal detected"}
      String.contains?(trimmed, [";", "&", "|", "`", "$(", "\n", "\r"]) ->
        {:error, "Dangerous characters in URL"}
      true ->
        {:ok, trimmed}
    end
  end
  defp validate_url(_), do: {:error, "URL must be a string"}

  defp validate_branch(branch) when is_binary(branch) do
    trimmed = String.trim(branch)
    if Regex.match?(~r/^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._\-\/]*$/, trimmed) do
      {:ok, trimmed}
    else
      {:error, "Invalid branch name"}
    end
  end
  defp validate_branch(_), do: {:error, "Branch must be a string"}

  defp validate_destination(dest) when is_binary(dest) do
    trimmed = String.trim(dest)
    cond do
      String.length(trimmed) > @max_path_length ->
        {:error, "Destination path too long"}
      String.contains?(trimmed, "..") ->
        {:error, "Path traversal in destination"}
      not Regex.match?(~r/^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._\-\/]*$/, trimmed) ->
        {:error, "Invalid destination path"}
      true ->
        {:ok, trimmed}
    end
  end
  defp validate_destination(_), do: {:error, "Destination must be a string"}

  defp ensure_directory(dest) do
    parent = Path.dirname(dest)
    case File.mkdir_p(parent) do
      :ok -> {:ok, parent}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, "Cannot create directory: #{reason}"}
    end
  end

  # Uses argument-list form to prevent shell injection
  defp execute_clone(url, dest) do
    args = ["clone", "--depth", "1", url, dest]
    case System.cmd("git", args, stderr_to_stdout: true) do
      {output, 0} -> {:ok, output}
      {error, code} -> {:error, "Clone failed (#{code}): #{error}"}
    end
  end

  # Uses argument-list form to prevent shell injection
  defp execute_clone_branch(url, branch, dest) do
    args = ["clone", "--depth", "1", "--branch", branch, url, dest]
    case System.cmd("git", args, stderr_to_stdout: true) do
      {output, 0} -> {:ok, output}
      {error, code} -> {:error, "Clone failed (#{code}): #{error}"}
    end
  end
end

defmodule BuildDeps do
  @moduledoc """
  Fetches build dependencies from configured repositories.
  Repository URLs come from a project configuration file.
  """

  @deps_dir "_deps"

  def fetch_all(config_path \\ "build_deps.json") do
    with {:ok, content} <- File.read(config_path),
         {:ok, config} <- Jason.decode(content),
         {:ok, deps} <- extract_deps(config) do
      results = Enum.map(deps, &fetch_dep/1)
      errors = Enum.filter(results, &match?({:error, _}, &1))
      if errors == [], do: {:ok, results}, else: {:error, errors}
    end
  end

  defp extract_deps(%{"dependencies" => deps}) when is_list(deps), do: {:ok, deps}
  defp extract_deps(_), do: {:error, "Invalid config format"}

  defp fetch_dep(%{"name" => name, "url" => url} = dep) do
    branch = Map.get(dep, "branch", "main")
    dest = Path.join(@deps_dir, name)

    if File.exists?(dest) do
      {:ok, "#{name} already fetched"}
    else
      case RepoManager.clone_with_branch(url, branch, dest) do
        {:ok, _} -> {:ok, "#{name} fetched successfully"}
        {:error, reason} -> {:error, "Failed to fetch #{name}: #{reason}"}
      end
    end
  end
  defp fetch_dep(_), do: {:error, "Invalid dependency format"}
end
